channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Search underway for Living Coast’s next executive director
item.description: Shayna Foreman, who was previously at the nonprofit as the director of education, was appointed the Living Coast's interim executive director.

item.title: Blood banks seeking donors, offering prizes through January
item.description: People who donate at any San Diego Blood Bank donor center or blood drive through Jan. 25 will receive a limited-edition T-shirt.

item.title: Section 8 housing assistance in jeopardy from proposed cuts, restrictions
item.description: The Trump administration and GOP lawmakers want steep funding cuts, while new eligibility rules from HUD would imperil housing for millions of people.

item.title: Chula Vista receives $1m in housing grants from city, state
item.description: The state grant will be matched with a $500,000 contribution from the city, which established a local housing trust fund in 2024.

item.title: Rain showers linger through Wednesday in San Diego County, but changes ahead
item.description: Isolated light to locally moderate rain showers are expected to continue through Wednesday across San Diego County, according to the National Weather Service.

item.title: Two men sentenced to life without parole for fatal 2021 Chollas Creek shooting
item.description: Two men convicted of the 2021 fatal shooting of a man whose body was found at Chollas Creek Open Space Park were sentenced Monday to life in prison without the possibility of parole.

item.title: CDC cuts number of vaccines recommended for every child
item.description: The U.S. took the unprecedented step Monday of cutting the number of vaccines it recommends for every child — a move that leading medical groups said would undermine protections against a half-dozen diseases.

item.title: 2 plead not guilty to federal charges alleging plot to bomb SoCal businesses
item.description: Two alleged members of an extremist group pleaded not guilty Monday to charges of planned coordinated bombing attacks on New Year's Eve across Southern California -- a suspected plot that was derailed by authorities weeks earlier.

item.title: Authorities ID four victims in recent San Diego County traffic fatalities
item.description: Authorities have publicly identified four people who lost their lives in recent weeks to San Diego-area traffic accidents.

item.title: California Supreme Court restores 30-foot height limit in Midway District
item.description: The California Supreme Court has rejected San Diego's bid to preserve a 2022 voter-approved measure that lifted the 30-foot coastal height limit in the Midway District, effectively ending the city's legal fight.
